2co-1-2.anchor: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

2co-1-10.anchor: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

2co-2-2.anchor: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

2co-2-11.anchor: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

2co-5-7.anchor: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

2co-6-3.anchor: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

2co-8-15.anchor: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

2co-8-24.anchor: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

2co-10-17.anchor: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

2co-11-8.anchor: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

2co-11-10.anchor: no man shall stop me of this boasting

2co-12-12.anchor: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

2co-12-17.anchor: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

2co-12-18.anchor: walked we not in the same spirit

2co-13-6.anchor: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

2co-13-8.anchor: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

2co-13-12.anchor: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
